ios.desc:
OpenClip for Safari is a browser extension that lets you watch social videos in your browser again.

By removing unnecessary tracking details from shared links, OpenClip helps you watch videos from friends and family without having to download social media apps or create accounts. The extension also cleans up video and profile pages for a distraction-free viewing experience.
